processing.upstream_pipeline: Parse MicroPython docs/library RST; enrich parameters and returns from reference/micropython without replacing documentation; copy curated aioespnow, asyncio and rp2 assembler reference modules; post-process with upstream formatter/import cleanup.
processing.local_processing: No stub text transformation. Import every file from the versioned published docstubs tree, supplementary reference/micropython .pyi modules absent from that tree, complete reference/_mpy_shed helper tree, and the published stdlib _typeshed helper.
processing.module_mapping: Remove .pyi and final /__init__, convert / to .; docstubs and reference directory prefixes identify original upstream trees and do not form part of module names.
processing.curated_reference_versions: Curated reference headers retain their upstream versions, often v1.24.0; they are not relabelled as generated v1.30.0 documentation.
processing.not_copied: Board-generated stubs, distribution build scripts, duplicate curated files already incorporated into docstubs, unrelated CPython stdlib stubs, and reference/micropython/samd/__init__.py (not a declaration file).
processing.support_scope: _mpy_shed contains MicroPython-specific helpers and typeshed-derived definitions. The pristine published _typeshed helper is typing support, not MicroPython API documentation. Existing separately vendored micropython-stdlib-stubs 1.29.0.post2 remains unchanged.
processing.limitations: Upstream skip policy omits some documentation modules including builtins and re; reference coverage and signatures are upstream material, not compiler authority. Imported runtime dependencies may be absent in the selected build and must not be added by reference application.
processing.refresh: Select a fixed micropython-stubs revision and its versioned *-docstubs tree; retain complete generated output and upstream notices, validate downloaded bytes against Git blob identities, regenerate schema-v1 byte pins and this provenance. Do not substitute the unversioned micropython-preview-docstubs alias.
